notes.title: 🏆 1000 ADVENTURERS HAVE JOINED THE GUILD! 🏆
notes.content:
[h1]🏆 1000 ADVENTURERS HAVE JOINED THE GUILD! 🏆[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556713/f886316a86bca2c6cb51f4f2da499cb8ae499253.png[/img]

Harem Dungeon has officially hit [b]1000 copies sold![/b]
That means over 1000 brave adventurers have joined the guild and descended into the dungeon in search of treasure, challenge… and lewd rewards! 💦

Thanks to all of you who believed in the project, shared your feedback, and helped us improve the game day after day. We’re just getting started!

👙 The girls are ready. The dungeon awaits. And your harem is only getting bigger.


🗺️ Don’t forget: we’ve already announced our seasonal content roadmap, with 3 major events coming this year (Summer, Halloween, Christmas), each with unique stages and 4 new scenes with themed outfits!

Join our [url="https://discord.gg/C5YfJp7dXc"]Discord server[/url] to share feedback, get support, or just hang out with fellow adventurers!

notes.title: ✨ HAREM DUNGEON – UI & QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATE! ✨
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just released a small but meaningful update focused on UI and quality of life improvements—not a patch, but something to make your experience even smoother!

[b]📜 Tutorial Improvements[/b]

The tutorials have received a visual upgrade to make them clearer and easier to follow.

We’ve also added a scroll-shaped icon on screen so you can now access the tutorials at any time 

[b]🎮 New Quality of Life Feature[/b]

You can now toggle third-frame content (you know… the juicy stuff 💦) directly with a new on-screen button!
No more using the C key on your keyboard—just click and go.

Thanks for all the suggestions that led to this! Keep them coming—we’re listening.

See you in the dungeon! 🗝️💖

notes.title: 🛠️ HAREM DUNGEON – FIFTH PATCH! 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just released a new patch to address some important issues reported by the community:

See you in the dungeon! 🗝️

notes.title: 🛠️ HAREM DUNGEON – FOURTH PATCH! 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just released a new patch for Harem Dungeon with several important fixes and improvements to enhance your experience.

[b]✨ What’s new:[/b]

Fixed the duration of the [b]bleed damage ability[/b] so that it now works as intended.

Fixed the duration of the [b]click damage boost ability[/b], ensuring it functions properly.

Increased the [b]maximum coin cap,[/b] letting you hold more coins at once.

Increased the [b]coin drop rate from monsters[/b] starting from stage 7 onwards, to help with progression.

Updated the [b]tooltips for all abilities[/b] to ensure they display correctly and consistently.

Fixed a graphical bug with the [b]player’s sword icon animation,[/b] which was displaying incorrectly.

Thank you so much for all your feedback—it helps us keep improving the game every day! 💪

💬 Join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/C5YfJp7dXc]Discord server[/url] and let us know what you think or if you run into any other issues.

See you in the dungeon! 🗝️

notes.title: HAREM DUNGEON - THIRD PATCH
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just released a new patch for Harem Dungeon with some[b] important[/b] balancing changes and new features to improve the gameplay experience!

[b]✨ What’s new:[/b]


[b]Monster Nerf:[/b] Starting from floor 200, enemies now have significantly reduced health to make the game more balanced at higher levels.


[b]Ability Caps:[/b]We’ve added caps to all player abilities to improve game balance:

Player Click

Damage-Dealing Ability

Ability that boosts click damage

Ability that boosts unit damage

[b]All[/b] of these now have a maximum level cap of 25.

[b]Unique Caps for Units:[/b] Each unit—Paladin, Archer, Boxer, and Assassin—now has a unique level cap tailored to their specific role and balance needs.

[b]Visual Improvement:[/b] When a unit or power-up reaches its maximum level, the Buy button now changes to Max to make it clear that no further upgrades are possible.


Thanks so much for all your feedback! These changes are designed to keep the game fun and challenging while giving you more control over your progress.

💬 Join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/C5YfJp7dXc]Discord server[/url] and share your thoughts—we’re here to listen and make the game even better together!

See you in the dungeon! 🗝️

notes.title: HAREM DUNGEON - SECOND PATCH!

notes.title: HAREM DUNGEON – FIRST PATCH!
notes.content:
[h1][b]HAREM DUNGEON – UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT![/b][/h1]

Hey everyone!

We’ve just released an update based on your valuable feedback from our Discord server and the community hub. Here’s what’s new:

✅ Dialogue Improvements – We’ve refined some of the dialogue lines based on your reports to make the experience smoother and more consistent (italian languages).

✅ Power-Up Visuals – We’ve enhanced the visual design of the power-up that collects coins. Now, when it reaches the maximum level, the Buy button will change to Max to make things clearer.

✅ Bug Fix – We fixed a small bug that was causing an achievement to unlock at the wrong time.

[h1][b]ONGOING FEEDBACK COLLECTION[/b][/h1]

We’re currently gathering feedback to understand how to improve monster balancing and power-up progression. Your input is incredibly valuable to us, so please consider joining our [b][url=https://discord.gg/C5YfJp7dXc]Discord server[/url] to share your thoughts or get any support you need!


[h1][b]SAVE FILES[/b][/h1]
If you’d like to test the updated dialogues (especially in Italian), you can delete your save files at the following path:
C:\Users\YOURUSERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\NyakuGames\HaremDungeon
⚠️ Note: We recommend this only for those playing in Italian or who want to experience the new dialogues from scratch.

Thank you all for your amazing support—we’re committed to making Harem Dungeon even better with your help!

See you in the dungeon! 🗝️

notes.title: HAREM DUNGEON – RELEASE AND FUTURE!
notes.content:
[b][h1]INTRODUCTION[/h1][/b]

We are very happy to announce the release of Harem Dungeon, a project we have worked on with great passion and that represents a new step forward in our growth path. With each game we learn more and more, thanks above all to the support and advice of the community that have helped us to constantly improve.

                                    [h1][b]A GAME BUILT WITH YOUR FEEDBACK[/b][/h1]

From day one, we’re dedicated to listening to your thoughts, suggestions, and expectations. Every piece of feedback will be incredibly valuable to us, as we aim to create a game that truly resonates with you and delivers the best possible experience.

[h2][b]A GAME THAT GROWS TOGETHER WITH YOU[/b][/h2]

We’re committed to actively balancing power-ups, enemies, bosses, and core mechanics based on your feedback. We’ll be checking in daily on our community channels to engage in discussions, answer your questions, and gather ideas for making Harem Dungeon even more fun and engaging.

[h1][b]STAY CONNECTED – JOIN US ON DISCORD![/b][/h1]

We’ve set up an official Discord server, where we’ll be hanging out every day, chatting with players, sharing updates, and collecting your feedback. It’s the perfect place to discuss strategies, report issues, and help us shape the future of the game together. [url=https://discord.gg/C5YfJp7dXc]DISCORD INVITE[/url]

[b][h2]THANK YOU FOR BEING PART OF THIS JOURNEY![/h2][/b]

one of this would be possible without your incredible support. We can’t wait to see you in the dungeon—let’s make this adventure unforgettable together!
